description: This is a Java interface defining methods for reading deposit account interest rate chart data within the Fineract project. It includes method signatures for retrieving interest rate chart data by ID, with slabs, using templates, and by account ID.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing read operations for deposit interest rate chart data in the savings module.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit interest rate chart data by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithSlabs
methods.description: Retrieves a deposit interest rate chart data with its slabs by chart ID.

methods.name: retrieveWithTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves chart data with a provided template data.

methods.name: retrieveOneWithSlabsOnAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves chart data with slabs based on the account ID.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template instance of deposit interest rate chart data.
